abilities.caveat: The 14s RES shred assumes the held cast consumed 2 Grimheart stacks. Each stack consumed gives 7s, and a hold that consumes none shreds nothing.
abilities.description:
Sharp frost, swift blade.

Press
Slashes swiftly, dealing Cryo DMG.
When it hits an opponent, Eula gains a stack of Grimheart that stacks up to 2 times. These stacks can only be gained once every 0.3s.

Grimheart
Increases Eula's resistance to interruption and DEF.

Hold
Wielding her sword, Eula consumes all the stacks of Grimheart and lashes forward, dealing AoE Cryo DMG to opponents in front of her.
If Grimheart stacks are consumed, surrounding opponents will have their Physical RES and Cryo RES decreased.
Each consumed stack of Grimheart will be converted into an Icewhirl Brand that deals Cryo DMG to nearby opponents.
_curatorNotes: Generator had 4 variants: Grimheart (duration 18), RES Decrease (duration 7), Press (cooldown 4), Hold (cooldown 10). Grimheart and RES Decrease entries were not proper AbilityVariant structures — removed. Grimheart buff (18s, capped at 2 stacks, refreshes on gain) still needs to be authored as an effect by reviewer.

Hold-variant Physical/Cryo resShred authored 2026-07-28 (capability sweep): gcsim skill.go:183-197 shredCB adds 'eula-icewhirl-shred-cryo' + 'eula-icewhirl-shred-phys', value -resRed[lvl], duration 7*v*60f (7s per Grimheart stack consumed, applied by the Icewhirl Brand hits); eula_gen.go:263-273 resRed at TL10 = 0.25. Authored at duration 14 = 2 stacks (standard Hold usage) with onCast skill on the Hold variant — the Zhongli Hold-E precedent; per-stack variability covered by the ability caveat.
Press hitmark: frame 20 (skillPressHitmark). Gains 1 Grimheart stack on hit with 0.3s ICD (18 frames, grimheartICD status).

Hold hitmark: frame 49 (skillHoldHitmark). Consumes all Grimheart stacks. If ≥1 stacks: applies Physical RES -resRed[lvl] and Cryo RES -resRed[lvl] for 7*stacksConsumed seconds via Icewhirl Brand hits at frames 79 and 92 (icewhirlHitmarks). resRed scales with talent level.

A1 (Roiling Rime): when Hold E consumes exactly 2 Grimheart stacks, spawns a Shattered Lightfall Sword dealing 50% of base Lightfall Physical DMG (burstExplodeBase*0.5). Hits at frame 108 (a1Hitmark). Effect not yet authored — needs reviewer pass.

C1 (Tidal Illusion): when Hold E consumes ≥1 Grimheart stacks, Eula gains PhyDMG%+30 for (6*stacksConsumed+6) seconds (max 18s). Likely onCast with hold-E condition + stack-count gating. gcsim: c1buff[PhyP]=0.3, duration=(6*v+6)*60 frames. Effect not yet authored — needs reviewer pass.

abilities.name: Glacial Illumination
abilities.description:
Brandishes her greatsword, dealing Cryo DMG to nearby opponents and creating a Lightfall Sword that follows her around for a duration of up to 7s.
While present, the Lightfall Sword increases Eula's resistance to interruption. When Eula's own Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst deal DMG to opponents, they will charge the Lightfall Sword, which can gain an energy stack once every 0.1s.
Once its duration ends, the Lightfall Sword will descend and explode violently, dealing Physical DMG to nearby opponents.
This DMG scales on the number of energy stacks the Lightfall Sword has accumulated.
If Eula leaves the field, the Lightfall Sword will explode immediately.
_curatorNotes: Lightfall Sword lifetime: status (burstKey) added at frame 117 (burstFrames[ActionWalk]=117) for 449 frames (600 - lightfallHitmark[35] - 117 + 1 = 449). 449/60 = 7.48s → duration=7.5. Explosion queued at frame 565 (600-lightfallHitmark), attack lands at frame 600. In-game description says 'up to 7s'; gcsim calculates ~7.5s from spawn.

Lightfall Sword charges via burstStackCB: any on-field hit from Eula's N/E/Q grants +1 stack with 0.1s ICD (6 frames). Stack cap: 30. Explosion DMG = burstExplodeBase[lvl] + burstExplodeStack[lvl] * stackCount.
terminatesOn: 'swap' — onCharacterSwap event triggers triggerBurst() if status is active (sword explodes immediately when Eula leaves field).
Initial burst Cryo hit at frame 100 (burstHitmark). This is separate from the Lightfall Sword explosion.

E (ActionSkill) cancel not explicitly assigned in burstFrames (InitAbilSlice(123) comment '// Q -> E' indicates 123 is intended E-cancel). Omitted per recipe rule — no explicit ActionSkill assignment line.
A4 (Wellspring of War-Lust): on Q cast, resets Icetide Vortex CD (ResetActionCooldown) and grants 1 Grimheart stack (gcsim: a4() called at Burst()). Effect not yet authored — needs reviewer pass.

C6 (Noble Obligation): burstCounter starts at 5 (instead of 0) at C6. Additionally, 50% chance per on-field hit to grant an extra stack (burstStackCB at Cons==6). Effect not yet authored — needs reviewer pass.

_curatorNotes: Migrated 2026-05-10 (E2 + schema-mismatch): rewrote stat hp% → burstDmgBonus, value 50 → 25, added trigger: passive + condition `enemyHpBelow: { threshold: 50 }` (new primitive). Schema cannot scope to Lightfall-only — gcsim applies DmgP=0.25 only to 'Glacial Illumination (Initial)' abil, but the buff here over-renders against ALL Eula burst DMG. Acceptable approximation since enemyHpBelow already renders optimistically. Tighter scoping would need a sub-burst stat key or per-buff abilityName filter.
[caption-sweep 2026-07-20] Caveat added when constellation passive-trigger bonuses were wired into the Always-on caption: the null-resolving gate lists optimistically.

notModeled.reason: The extra Lightfall Sword stacks are a 50% chance. The Rotation Planner doesn't simulate chance, so the same rotation always draws the same bars for everyone. The starting stacks only raise its damage, which the Rotation Planner doesn't draw.
